text_block_list.text:
One day, Maruzensky notified me that today 
was "the promised day," so when I headed 
to the front of the station—
(VROOM VRRRROOOOOM!!)

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Hiii, Trainer-kun. Living your youth to 
the fullest?

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Hiii, Trainer-chan. Living your youth to 
the fullest?

There stood Maruzensky, striking a 
flawless pose next to her beloved red car.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
"My mom told me that when I talked to her 
on the phone the other day."

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
"She said, 'Look at you, living your youth 
to the fullest! Make sure you show some 
gratitude to your Trainer.'"

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
That's why I came to deliver gratitude and 
youth! Along with a one-way ticket to 
youth♪

What Maruzensky showed me after saying 
that was—

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: —Namely, a hot spring trip voucher!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
By the way, refusing passengers is not an 
option~

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
From what I remember—Trainer-kun, you 
promised you'd 'keep me company'!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
From what I remember—Trainer-chan, you 
promised you'd 'keep me company'!

If I remember correctly... I believe we 
made that promise when I won the hot 
spring trip tickets from the shopping 
district lottery.
choice_data_list: OK! Shall we take the train?

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Oh, but wouldn't that be mean to Tacchan? 
Come on, right this way to the passenger 
seat~♪

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Once we get to the inn, we're taking a hot 
spring bath! Drinking milk, and having a 
pillow fight!!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
I'm gonna live my youth to the absolute 
fullest!!

...And so, after being shaken violently in 
Maruzensky's beloved car, we somehow made 
it to the hot springs, but—

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: Cleaning up?

text_block_list.name: Landlady of the Inn
text_block_list.text:
I am terribly sorry. It pains me greatly 
to keep our guests waiting, but...

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
No, no, we get to soak in a beautiful 
bath, after all! That just makes me look 
forward to it even more!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
"Can't be helped, Trainer. Care to kill 
some time together?"
choice_data_list: How about relaxing in our own rooms?

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Can't be helped, Trainer-chan. Wanna kill 
a little time together?
choice_data_list: How about relaxing in our own rooms?

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Non-non! Maruzen-chan's way of killing 
time in her youth plan is――

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Mmm... The breeze feels so refreshing! Oh, 
look, there's even a river!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Hey, buddy! Wanna kick off your shoes and 
play?
choice_data_list:
Going in the river barefoot makes me feel 
like a kid.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Hey, girlie! Wanna kick off your shoes and 
play?
choice_data_list:
Going in the river barefoot makes me feel 
like a kid.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, that's right. After all, this is a 
youth plan!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
So why don't you try being a kid just for 
today?

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: It's just the two of us here, after all.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: Ahaha, nice response!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Well then, let's get into the summer 
vacation spirit and have tons of fun!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: Come on, come on! Let's go~!
(Splish splash!)

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha, feels soo good! Trainer-kun, let 
'er rip!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha, feels soo good! Trainer-chan, let 
'er rip!

And so, I continued to play in the river 
with Maruzensky until the sun went down.

By the time we returned to the inn, we 
were completely drenched, and headed to 
the hot springs with a laugh.
(Shaaaaa...)

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: Owwch! Wait, what is this...?

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
"...I'm hopeless too, huh~ Forgetting to 
put on sunscreen, of all things."

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, I wonder which one of them is more 
into it.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, I wonder which one of them is more 
into it.
In the bath...

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Hiii, Trainer-kun. How was the bath? The 
best, right?
In the bath...

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Hiii, Trainer-chan. How was the bath? The 
best, right?

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Aha, looks like you're having a blast, and 
that's what matters!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Alright, next we drink milk! And finally, 
pillow fight in one of our rooms!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Let's keep enjoying our youth together, 
okay?

It was a moment where I felt an 
irreplaceable bond with Maruzensky...
